Where Does Freedom of Speech End?
That's the thing. People WILL get offended...but where do you draw the line?

The government cannot limit your freedom of speech unless you're openly inciting violence or very likely going to get someone hurt (fire in a crowded theater thing). Companies can institute policies that limit it on their premises or on their time if you're an employee. And if you mouth off to someone and they clock you, it's your own fault; many places still have a "fighting words" defense for assault.

Freedom of Speech means you have the freedom to say whatever the hell you want.It does not protect you from the ridicule of your peers, violence, or death. It only protects you from your government (in theory at any rate).

That's my take on it, at any rate.
